# Golden Flowers

> Golden Flowers is a Lake Tahoe wedding florist creating elevated, sustainably grown floral artistry for couples getting married across the Sierra Nevada. Brittany, the owner and lead designer, is an artist and an agronomist with a master's degree in agronomy. Many of the flowers are field-grown on the studio's own organic and regenerative farm in Nevada County, California, about an hour from Lake Tahoe, and the rest come from trusted local growers. The studio caps its calendar each season and intentionally takes fewer weddings than most studios, so each wedding gets weeks of sourcing and design work.

Key facts:
- Based in Incline Village, Nevada, by appointment only. Phone: (530) 557-7689.
- Serves North and South Lake Tahoe, Truckee, Incline Village, Olympic Valley, Nevada City, Grass Valley, and the greater Sierra Nevada.
- Design is foam-free and seasonal, with reusable mechanics and locally grown stems.
- Couples start by sharing their date and venue through the consultation form; the studio replies, usually within 48 hours.

## Services

Full-service wedding floral design, built custom for each wedding with no packages or minimums: bridal and bridesmaid bouquets, ceremony installations and arches, reception centerpieces and tablescapes, and personal flowers such as boutonnieres and corsages. Most weddings start around $5,000; ambitious, installation-heavy visions run $25,000 and up.

## Design philosophy

- Three design directions couples ask for most: Lush & Romantic, Elevated Minimalist, and Wildflower Modern, with every style designed on request
- Seasonal flowers grown on the studio's own farm or sourced from California growers
- Foam-free, with reusable mechanics and composting
- Arrangements designed to belong in the Sierra Nevada landscape and to hold up in mountain conditions: wind, altitude, heat, and full sun

## Venues

Golden Flowers designs regularly at Edgewood Tahoe, The Ritz-Carlton Lake Tahoe at Northstar, Thunderbird Lodge, Palisades High Camp, Martis Camp, Schaffer's Camp, the Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe, the Hellman-Ehrman Mansion at Sugar Pine Point, the North Tahoe Event Center, Gar Woods Grill & Pier, Heavenly, Old Greenwood, Valhalla Tahoe, The Miner's Foundry, the National Exchange Hotel, and private estates across the region.
